description: Money-free world state of the pre-C2 code (4950b10, identical to bc94b31 in the simulation) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts /tmp/fls-c2-old <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money and Building.upkeepUnpaid.
